title_en: DUPLEX FOR SALE IN THE HILLS OF THE SUN!
description_en: The duplex is located on the fifth and sixth floor of a new building with an elevator. It has a total area of 189.4 square meters and two extra-priced garages with an area of 46 and 16 square meters. It has luxury furniture and high-quality investments, including: Wooden parquets. Central heating. Multisplit air conditioning system. Functional fireplace in the living room. Ceiling windows with dashboard. Incaso toilets. 78 net meters: A small entrance corridor A spacious living room Cooking and dining area A bedroom A toilet #2nd floor with a space of 87 net meters + 6.4 meters of veranda A living room A wardrobe room A normal bedroom An external toilet A matrimonial room with an internal toilet On the -1st floor of the building there are also two garages with shutters, with an extra price, one with a space of 46 meters and room for 2 vehicles parked and the other 16 meters and space for one vehicle. The property has regular mortgage documentation for both the apartment and the garages. Possibility of purchase with credit. For more information, or a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us!
